title: Electrical System Integration Engineer - New Grad
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE
Applied Intuition is seeking a New Grad Electrical Systems Integration Engineer to work across vehicle electrical architecture and bench validation. You will design automotive-grade wire harnesses and build out the hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) benches and firmware bringup workflows that validate them - working alongside senior engineers, cross-functional teams, and suppliers to take electrical systems from schematic to a running vehicle.

This role is open to candidates who graduated in summer 2026 or will graduate by the end of 2026.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Design the routing and retention of harnesses, cables, and connectors to ensure ease of assembly, serviceability, and robust functionality

- Build, instrument, and maintain hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) test benches used for electrical system integration and validation

- Perform firmware bringup on new ECUs and vehicle hardware - flashing, debugging boot and communication issues, and validating interfaces (CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet) against spec

- Develop BOMs, wire, and material specifications

- Create and manage CAD (3D models, assemblies, 2D drawings) using SolidWorks and Altium for low-voltage, high-voltage, and high-speed vehicle interconnects

- Write scripts and tooling to automate bench test execution and data capture

- Interface cross-functionally to drive program delivery

- Work with OEMs, vendors, and partners (current and potential) to identify the best solutions for Applied Intuition's vehicle platform

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or an equivalent program, completed in 2026 (summer or fall/winter graduates welcome)

- Coursework, internship, research, or project experience in electrical hardware design, embedded systems, or test bench development

- Hands-on lab skills: comfort with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, bench supplies, soldering, and crimping

- Familiarity with embedded C/C++ and a scripting language such as Python

- Exposure to serial and vehicle communication protocols (CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, or Ethernet)

- Willingness to work hands-on in a lab and vehicle garage environment

NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience with wire harness design and automotive standards (IPC/WHMA-A-620, ISO 6722, SAE J1128)

- Experience with HiL platforms or bench automation frameworks (dSPACE, NI/VeriStand, Vector CANoe, or custom rigs)

- Firmware bringup experience on a new board or ECU - bootloaders, JTAG/SWD debugging, peripheral configuration

description:
Role Overview

You’ll be a strategic HR Business Partner, working closely with leaders to shape how people are hired, developed, motivated, and retained. In this role, you’ll support Customer Support, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams while turning people and organizational insights into clear, practical actions that strengthen performance and culture.

You’ll advise leaders on organizational design, coach managers, and use data to identify trends before they become issues. You’ll also be the go-to partner for employee relations in India, helping resolve complex situations with sound judgment, empathy, and a strong understanding of local employment law.

Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)

•
Partner with business leaders as a trusted advisor on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, and people strategies.

•
Use qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, inform decisions, and translate analysis into clear priorities and actions.

•
Lead and resolve complex employee relations matters in India, ensuring fair, compliant, and timely outcomes.

•
Design, improve, and deliver programs across performance management, career development, coaching, and recognition to support managers and individual contributors.

•
Drive key HR cycles, including performance, compensation, and talent reviews, within your business area while aligning with global standards and practices.

•
Stay current on HR best practices and regulatory changes, and proactively guide leaders on their implications for teams.

These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview

•
5+ years of relevant experience as an HR Business Partner or in a similar HR role.

•
Hands-on experience managing employee relations in India, including complex and sensitive cases.

•
Proven ability to partner with and influence stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.

•
Track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and delivering complex, time-sensitive work.

•
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.

•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present and facilitate confidently.

•
Strong interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to build trust and follow through on commitments.

It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t

•
Experience supporting Customer Support, Customer Success, Professional Services, Technology, Product, or similar teams.

•
A bachelor’s degree in psychology, business administration, communications, human resources, or a related field.

•
A track record of being adaptable, curious, and proactive, with strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills.

About Us

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

title: Account Manager
description:
L'équipe Account Manager s'agrandit !

AssessFirst , en quelques mots 👇
Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale .
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays , pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.
Ce que tu feras :
En tant qu’ Account Manager Full Cycle , tu occupes un rôle stratégique au sein de l’équipe commerciale et prends la responsabilité d’un portefeuille de clients existants.
Ta mission : développer durablement la valeur de ton portefeuille , en pilotant l’ensemble du cycle de vie client, de l’onboarding au renouvellement, en passant par l’adoption et l’expansion.
Ton rôle s’articule autour de trois priorités :

• Sécuriser : anticiper les renouvellements, protéger le revenu récurrent et limiter le churn.

• Développer : identifier et convertir les opportunités d’upsell et d’expansion pour faire croître l’ARR de ton portefeuille.

• Accompagner : assurer l’onboarding, favoriser l’adoption et construire une relation client créatrice de valeur dans la durée.

Missions
Fidéliser & sécuriser ton portefeuille

• Piloter ton portefeuille dans une logique de rétention et de développement du revenu récurrent .

• Identifier les risques de désengagement et mettre en place les actions nécessaires pour prévenir le churn.

• Anticiper les échéances contractuelles et piloter les renouvellements suffisamment en amont.

• Mener les négociations de renouvellement en sécurisant le revenu et en favorisant, lorsque cela est pertinent, des engagements à plus long terme.

• Suivre la santé de tes comptes grâce aux données d’usage, aux niveaux d’engagement et aux différents signaux clients.

Développer l’ARR de ton portefeuille

• Identifier et convertir les opportunités d’ upsell et d’expansion : nouveaux utilisateurs, extension de périmètre, fonctionnalités, formations ou services complémentaires.

• Construire des stratégies de développement adaptées au potentiel et aux enjeux de chaque compte.

• Transformer les signaux d’usage et d’adoption en opportunités commerciales concrètes .

• Piloter tes opportunités d’expansion de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la négociation et au closing.

• Collaborer avec les équipes BDR et Marketing pour maximiser le potentiel de développement de ton portefeuille.

• Prendre en charge et développer les nouveaux comptes qui te sont attribués.

Onboarder & accélérer l’adoption

• Piloter l’ onboarding des nouveaux clients autour de leurs cas d’usage, objectifs et KPIs de succès.

• Définir les premiers jalons permettant aux clients de percevoir rapidement la valeur d’ AssessFirst .

• Favoriser l’activation et la récurrence d’usage dès les 30 à 60 premiers jours .

• Assurer une transition fluide entre l’onboarding et la gestion long terme du compte.

Créer et démontrer de la valeur

• Comprendre les enjeux business et RH de tes clients pour faire évoluer leur utilisation d’ AssessFirst .

• Les accompagner dans la traduction de leurs usages en résultats business mesurables .

• Animer des Success Reviews régulières pour valoriser les résultats obtenus et identifier les prochaines opportunités.

• Renforcer la perception de valeur tout au long de la relation, notamment en préparation des renouvellements et des discussions d’expansion.

• Adopter une véritable posture de conseil , capable de challenger et d’accompagner les clients dans leurs enjeux.

Piloter ton activité & ton portefeuille

• Être l’ interlocuteur privilégié des clients de ton portefeuille et garantir un suivi régulie

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries-continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

The Head of Enterprise Sales, North America will own all commercial outcomes across the region, with a mandate split equally between expanding our existing enterprise footprint and aggressively acquiring new logos. - Target minimum £200K ACV per new logo with clear path to seven-figure expansion

- Own NRR targets of 130-140% across the regional book of business

- Drive expansion of existing accounts into new business lines, jurisdictions, and user groups

- Lead commercial negotiations on renewal and expansion agreements at enterprise level

Team Leadership

- Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing sales team across the full North America region

title: RFP Manager (f/d/m)
description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

We are looking for an RFP Manager to join our team. Moving beyond traditional bid coordination, this role requires an operational partner to own the complete proposal lifecycle, structure complex cross-functional inputs, and convert technical solution details into winning enterprise proposals. You will combine commercial rigor with polished execution to ensure enterprise buyers experience high-impact, compliant deliverables at every stage of the evaluation process.

YOUR MISSION

- Own the end-to-end RFP process, serving as the lead on RFP strategy formulation and strict timeline adherence to ensure on-time, high-quality submissions.

- Rally cross-functional deal teams across Sales, Climate Strategy & Solutions, Operations, Supply, Risk, Legal and Finance to streamline deliverable workflows and align responses with client-specific requirements.

- Analyze opportunity dynamics and competitive landscapes to translate complex operational capabilities into clear, high-converting client communications.

- Develop and maintain a library of reusable content, templates, and proposal resources, enabling faster turnaround times and consistent pre-sales execution.

- Conduct systematic win/loss post-mortems to identify operational improvements, using deal data to refine future proposal strategy alongside Sales.

- Partner with Sales and Marketing to continuously elevate proposal templates and pitch materials.

REQUIREMENTS

- 3-5 years of experience in bid management, proposal operations, or complex project management, with a track record of driving flawless execution on large enterprise tenders.

- Exceptional project management capabilities and operational discipline, with the proven ability to structure complex deliverables under tight deadlines.

- Highly analytical mindset with a strong command of data modelling and presentation tools (Excel/Google Sheets, Google Slides), capable of translating complex metrics into polished client-facing assets.

- Polished verbal and written communication skills, with the executive presence required to confidently engage and align with senior stakeholders.

- Fluency in English is required. German fluency is a bonus.

- Understanding of the Voluntary Carbon Market is a plus.

THE HIRING PROCESS

- An intro call with the People Team.

- A call with Juliane Sterzl, CRO

- Meeting with Matt Schmid, our SVP of Sales

- Case study with Juliane Sterzl & Magnus Drewelies, our CEO & Founder

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU AT CEEZER?

- A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.

- Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.

- True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.

As the home of the open-source Redis project and the provider of Redis Enterprise, we're at the forefront of solving critical challenges for businesses that need speed, reliability, and scale. Our mission is to build innovative data solutions that empower developers and organizations worldwide to create real-time applications that transform industries.

- Advocate for customer needs internally, collaborating with Product, Support, and Engineering teams to resolve issues and influence roadmap priorities.

Customer Enablement and Success Planning

- Develop tailored success plans to guide large, matrixed customer organizations toward their desired outcomes with Redis solutions.

Retention and Growth

- Identify and nurture expansion opportunities within complex, multi-stakeholder accounts, partnering with Sales to drive upsell and cross-sell initiatives.

- Track account health through regular check-ins with both technical and executive stakeholders, identifying and mitigating risks early.

- Ensure contract renewals by demonstrating ongoing value and supporting the evolving needs of large-scale, enterprise customers.

Executive Engagement

title: Senior Director, New Product Planning
description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

Reporting to the SVP of Corporate Development and Strategy, the Senior Director, New Product Planning will help shape the company’s future portfolio by leading commercial strategy for pipeline assets, identifying lifecycle opportunities, evaluating external innovation, and helping define new areas for growth.

This individual will serve as the commercial strategy lead for pre-Phase 3 programs and partner closely with Research, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, US and International Commercial, Business Development, Corporate Strategy, and Finance to integrate scientific, clinical, commercial, and financial perspectives into key development and investment decisions.

The ideal candidate combines scientific depth with strong commercial judgment and strategic and financial acumen. A core aspect of the role is connecting science with strategy- to identify new indications, evaluate portfolio opportunities, and shape clinical development and investment decisions to align with unmet need, competitive landscape, and strategic value drivers.

Business Development & External Innovation

• Lead commercial assessments of licensing, acquisition, and partnership opportunities, integrating scientific rationale, unmet need, clinical profile, competitive landscape, commercial potential, pricing and market access, and strategic fit.

• Conduct primary and secondary market research to develop patient-based forecasts, scenario analyses, and risk-adjusted valuations to support investment and transaction decisions.

• Partner with Business Development, R&D, Finance, and US and Global Commercial throughout opportunity evaluation and diligence.

  Pipeline & Lifecycle Strategy

• Serve as the commercial strategy lead on cross-functional product teams for pre-Phase 3 pipeline programs before transition

• Develop business cases and commercial strategies for pipeline assets, including indication prioritization, Target Product Profiles, patient segmentation, value story, competitive differentiation, market opportunity, and lifecycle planning.

• Partner with Research, Clinical Development, Market Access, and Medical Affairs to incorporate commercial considerations into development strategy, including patient populations, endpoints, comparators, and real-world / health economic evidence generation.

• Partner with US and Global Commercial leaders to incorporate perspectives from key markets and ensure effective transition of assets into late-stage commercial planning.

Portfolio & Corporate Strategy

• Evaluate new therapeutic areas and disease spaces by integrating disease biology, unmet need, competitive dynamics, development feasibility, and commercial potential.

• Shape portfolio and corporate strategy by identifying growth opportunities, strategic gaps, and priorities for investment and resource allocation.

• Own commercial assumptions that inform long range planning for all pre-Ph3 programs

• Monitor scientific, clinical, competitive, regulatory, and market developments and translate them into implications for product and portfolio strategy.
